entries.title: Movement and the mind
entries.content: Regular physical activity is linked with better mood, focus and brain health as we age. Some activity is better than none.
entries.source: Yoga for Health: What the Science Says - NCCIH; Meditation benefits review - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Balance practice
entries.content: Balance and posture exercises, like gentle yoga, can improve stability. NCCIH notes this may lower fall risk in older adults.
entries.source: Yoga for Health: What the Science Says - NCCIH (NIH)
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Light movement and energy
entries.content: Reviews find light-to-moderate movement can help people feel less tired and sleep better. Start small and build up.
entries.source: Systematic Review for Medical Applications of Meditation - PMC
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only

entries.title: Mindful movement
entries.content: Moving slowly with attention, as in yoga or tai chi, can lower feelings of stress. It also builds body awareness.
entries.label: Evidence summary - education only
